scope: First SkillHone exact-asset adversarial refresh attempt
summary: Three infrastructure paths failed before the successful rerun: the generic project environment lacked requests for Forgejo status, the first non-interactive push lacked credentials, and the Codex-bundled old evaluation harness produced no answer artifact or score.
evidence: The first status.py invocation raised ModuleNotFoundError: requests before any Forgejo API request.
The first git push preserved local commit 6e18538 but failed with could not read Username; a later process-local token header pushed the same commit without writing credentials to disk or output.
The old harness retained one partial-finger-q trajectory whose Qwen session emitted pseudo-tool text but never wrote answer.txt; the run stopped without score.json.
The experiment directory and failing trajectory remain preserved and were not overwritten.
lessons: SkillHone status and evaluation must use its dedicated virtual environment and the validated provider-aware Ollama direct-JSON router.
A failed harness run is infrastructure evidence, not a skill-quality score.
limitations: This attempt produced no complete adversarial score and cannot be compared numerically with the champion.
next_actions: Use ~/.skillhone/venv for Forgejo tools, ~/.skillhone/skills/skillhone for the provider router, and a new output directory for the complete seven-item rerun.
